# Test fixtures

`pothole.jpg` is `pic-183-_jpg.rf.277cfed19f046acc63dc9640b239f1df.jpg` from the
validation split of *Pothole_Segmentation_YOLOv8* (Roboflow Universe,
https://universe.roboflow.com/farzad/pothole_segmentation_yolov8, export of
2023-10-20), licensed CC BY 4.0. It is used only to check that the service returns
a confident detection for an in-distribution photo. It is not a test-set image and
says nothing about model accuracy (see feedback/action.md, A2 and A5).
